bullets: A sponsored proposal card now shows when its last refresh failed instead of silently dropping the block.
Gemini 3.8 Flash is now selectable for Pro subscribers and as a plan-metered model.
Solar Pro 4 no longer carries an experimental label and appears as a standard model option.
An open model picker now wakes and applies scheduled price changes at fetch time.
GLM 5.3 Flash is now the default model across the CLI and Web surfaces.
The CLI picker and session summary now render prices and balances in Freebucks.
The CLI now shows a one-time Meet Freebucks card above the picker on first launch.
The Freebucks header now shows a daily reset countdown alongside the balance.
CLI landing screens now show whole days left instead of raw hours for monthly waits.
A referral banner now switches to Freebucks-only copy for metered accounts.
Rate-limited and spend-limited CLI responses now keep the Freebucks balance displayed.
Escape now closes the sponsor dock detail panel without changing its other meanings.
Ctrl+O now toggles the sponsor dock detail panel.
Freebuff Pro sponsor breaks now show a full-screen hero image card.
Sponsor break headlines can now bold a single word on the Desktop card.
SPOTLIGHT ad cards now keep a short dismiss lock before allowing quick close.
Bonus balance dates now stay visible with cancellation scheduled, disappearing only when the plan ends.
